dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Tch. Nothing through the smuggling pipeline either, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: What can I do for you? If you're a tourist, go look for the Outlander Affairs Agency.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Momoyo?

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Who? You've got the wrong person.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I must have mistaken you for someone else. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry about that. What are you going by nowadays?

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: I don't know what you're talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright. Looks like there's no hiding from you. Just call me "Chitose" for now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New mission, Chitose?

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Fine. I can tell you — I do still owe you, after all. Hmph. Would make it easier for you to watch your own back, too. You've got Fatui enemies everywhere, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: I'm still investigating that "Teacher" character. We captured one of his aides, and "persuaded" him to provide us with some interesting information.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: This "Teacher" was originally an instructor at the House of the Hearth. When the title of "The Knave" changed hands, he broke off with some unsuspecting subordinates and pursued the previous Knave's directives.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Lyudochka...

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Lyudochka? I don't recall anyone by the name. Don't you mean "Gendou Ringo"?

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: And those broken pieces of paper aren't giving her too much trouble, are they?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Changes?

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Several years ago, a serious clash appears to have occurred between the previous Knave and a certain child at the House of the Hearth — this led to the latter replacing the former.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Of course, this assumes that our captive speaks the truth. Taking a Fatuus's words at face value would be the height of folly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't know?

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: The "Teacher" appears to be using The Knave's name to keep a hold over his subordinates as they act across various nations — his goal and present affiliation, however, are unclear.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: He has likely left some "tacks" within Inazuma. My goal is to find every last one — and pluck them out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's doing a great job at the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Hmph. Good. She's more suited to that work than I.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: You should be taking care of yourself — you and your floating white friend. Keep getting yourself in trouble like this, and you'll grieve "Gendou Ringo"'s poor heart.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope everything goes well for you.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Heh. Rather than wish me well, you'd best take care of yourself. You'll grieve people if you keep rushing into danger the way you have until now.
